title: LinkedIn says it will keep its investments in GPUs, compute, and storage capacity flat during FY 2027, after doubling its GPU efficiency in the past six months (Paresh Dave/Wired)
summary: Paresh Dave / Wired: LinkedIn says it will keep its investments in GPUs, compute, and storage capacity flat during FY 2027, after doubling its GPU efficiency in the past six months — Despite the ongoing AI boom, LinkedIn is holding the line on compute spending. Instead, it's challenging engineers to make every GPU count.
